item.stem: Meera's grandmother says that the small intestine is only a thin tube that passes food to the large intestine. Meera explains that the small intestine does much more. Which row of the table correctly describes what happens in the small intestine?

options.A: receives digestive secretions ✓; basic pancreatic juice neutralises acidic food ✓; carbohydrates, proteins and fats digested ✓; nutrients absorbed into blood ✓
options.B: receives digestive secretions ✓; basic pancreatic juice neutralises acidic food ✗; carbohydrates, proteins and fats digested ✓; nutrients absorbed into blood ✗

options.D: receives digestive secretions ✓; basic pancreatic juice neutralises acidic food ✓; carbohydrates, proteins and fats digested ✗; nutrients absorbed into blood ✗
